title: explorer-verify event
description: One stage event, as VerifyOptions.onEvent receives it (R-DX-6). Every value is flat and JSON-safe, and API keys are removed from every string. Within a schema version, a release may add event types and fields and changes nothing else, so readers ignore fields they do not know. A new value of state or reason is a schema change.

entry.description: Zero-based index into verifyEach backends. Absent for other calls.

apiHost.description: The API host only: no scheme, path or query.

routedBy.description: How the backend was chosen. caller: the caller named it (route.backend, --backend). table: the routing table picked the first backend the chain lists that needs no key or has one. fallback: the chain has no row and the Sourcify fallback was allowed. api-url: the caller named the server (route.apiUrl, --api-url).

skipped.description: Present when routedBy is table and the table passed over backends listed before this one, because each needs an API key and none is set: their names joined with commas, in table order.
